t: AIO Robotics - Crunchbase Company Profile & Funding
s: AIO Robotics is the next generation 3D printer company from Los Angeles, CA. They developed the world's first All-In-One 3D Printer ZEUS that can scan, edit, and print 3D objects with the touch of a button. ZEUS has an integrated high-speed computer and a large touchscreen, thus it is a stand-alone device with powerful on-board features.
